$comment: MUT-326, ADR-155: the one place Mutaba3a's public hosts live. Everything else (vite, the bundle allowlist, the server release scripts, Terraform's Cloud Run env and front door, Sentry, the phone lines `npm run domain:plan` prints) derives from this file. `domain` is the apex (e.g. "example.com"): the landing moves there, the portal and API to <portalSubdomain>.<apex>, and the `legacy` hosts keep answering. `stage` walks the move in server/DEPLOYMENT.md §5a's order: "legacy" (no domain), "proxy" (the front door is built and verified; builds still use the legacy hosts), "live" (builds, links and the phone use the new hosts), "redirect" (old-host pages are sent on; only once the carry-over has shipped). scripts/__tests__/no-hardcoded-hosts.test.ts fails if these hosts appear anywhere else.
